en.title: Suppliers
en.summary: Who you buy from, their details, and what you have bought from each.

sections.heading: Managing them
sections.body:
• Suppliers lists them all with their contact details.
• Add Supplier creates one: name, TIN, phone, email and address.
• Open a supplier to see the purchases recorded against them.

sections.heading: Deleting is safe
sections.body: Deleting a supplier hides them from the pickers but leaves the purchase history intact. That is why last year's figures do not change when you tidy the list — and why a supplier you no longer use should be deleted rather than renamed into a different one.

sections.heading: Comparing spend
sections.body: Use the advanced filter for the questions the menus cannot answer — "spend over 10,000", "added in the last 90 days". Then export the result for the conversation you were about to have.

sections.heading: አያያዝ
sections.body:
• አቅራቢዎች ሁሉንም ከመገናኛ መረጃቸው ጋር ይዘረዝራል።
• Add Supplier አዲስ ይፈጥራል፦ ስም፣ ቲን ቁጥር፣ ስልክ፣ ኢሜይልና አድራሻ።
• በእነሱ ላይ የተመዘገቡ ግዢዎችን ለማየት አቅራቢውን ይክፈቱ።

sections.heading: መሰረዝ አደጋ የለውም
sections.body: አቅራቢን መሰረዝ ከምርጫዎች ይደብቀዋል እንጂ የግዢ ታሪኩን አይነካም። ዝርዝሩን ሲያጸዱ የአምናው አኃዝ የማይቀየረውም ለዚህ ነው — የማይጠቀሙበትን አቅራቢ ወደ ሌላ ስም ከመቀየር ይልቅ መሰረዝ የሚሻለውም ለዚህ ነው።

sections.heading: ወጪን ማነጻጸር
sections.body: ምናሌዎቹ መመለስ የማይችሏቸውን ጥያቄዎች ለመጠየቅ የላቀውን ማጣሪያ ይጠቀሙ — "ከ10,000 በላይ ወጪ"፣ "ባለፉት 90 ቀናት የተጨመሩ"። ከዚያ ውጤቱን ወደ ውጭ አውጥተው ለሚያደርጉት ውይይት ይጠቀሙበት።
